title: GradLIME: A CNN Local Interpretation Model Based on Feature Gradient Activation (Code)
description:
Official implementation of GradLIME, a CNN local interpretation model based on feature gradient activation.

The repository contains the core GradLIME method, the ablation study scripts (A1c_CAM_mode to A9_RUNTIME), and the evaluation utilities used to produce the results reported in the manuscript.

Companion preprint: GradLIME: A CNN Local Interpretation Model Based on Feature Gradient Activation, Research Square (under review at Scientific Reports).
notes: Code repository for the GradLIME manuscript currently under review at Scientific Reports. The related preprint DOI will be updated to the journal DOI once the article is accepted and published.
